description: Lists Hemrock financial-modeling concept docs — the methodology behind the math (exit waterfalls, anti-dilution, convertibles, cohorts, circular references, unit economics, and more). Returns a compact index of slugs, titles, and descriptions. Optionally filter by template_name or tag. Call get_concept to read the full text of any entry.

tag.description: Optional. Filter to concepts whose tags contain this string (e.g. "cap tables").

template_name.description: Optional. Filter to concepts relevant to a specific Hemrock template.

name: list_concepts
title: List Hemrock modeling concepts
